method: Exact roster handle plus country matched to stable identity records; profile links extracted from the existing historical tournament references. Only the profile infobox headshot is selected. Card fallbacks require one consistent linked account ID and a successful non-fallback image response. Source and cropped contact sheets visually reviewed. Separate identity records sharing an explicitly linked profile are retained rather than merged.
